entries.title: Your own panels can show your look and music settings
entries.body: A panel you or your first mate make can now show whether the ambient music is on or paused, its style and volume, and your theme, fonts, window size and a few other settings, updating as you change them. Settings that name your projects, computers or accounts stay out of reach.
entries.noPicture: Nothing in the app looks different until one of your own panels reads a setting.
